title: Coinbase Says Its AI Blocked $4.7 Million in Deepfake Elon Musk Scam
content: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Says Its AI Blocked $4.7 Million in Deepfake Elon Musk Scam Coinbase said its AI scam-prevention agent stopped about $4.7 million, roughly 91% of what customers tried to send, from reaching scammers running a deepfake Elon Musk crypto giveaway. This post Coinbase Says Its AI Blocked $4.7 Million in Deepfake Elon Musk Scam first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: New York State Pension Fund Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake by More Than 10%
content: Bitcoin Magazine New York State Pension Fund Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake by More Than 10% New York's state pension fund raised its Strategy (MSTR) stake to 352,850 shares worth $54.0 million at Sept. 30, a gain of more than 10% from June 30, its latest 13F shows. title: South Korea Set to Let 3,500 Companies Buy Bitcoin, Report Says
content: Bitcoin Magazine South Korea Set to Let 3,500 Companies Buy Bitcoin, Report Says South Korea's Financial Services Commission plans to release guidelines next week that would let about 3,500 listed companies and professional-investor firms invest in bitcoin and other crypto, News1 reported. This post South Korea Set to Let 3,500 Companies Buy Bitcoin, Report Says first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
